datenschutz.title: Privacy policy
datenschutz.controllerText: The operator named in the legal notice is responsible for processing your data.
datenschutz.dataText: Your name, email address and avatar, your channel memberships, and the messages, reactions and files you send. Other users in the workspace see your name, avatar, email address and whether you are currently online.
datenschutz.loginText: Login runs through our own login service. If you log in with Google, Google sends us your name and email address; we do not use your Google picture. DABubble sets no tracking or advertising cookies.
datenschutz.storageText: We keep your data for as long as your account exists. Deleted messages and their files are removed at once; uploaded files that were never sent after about a day.
datenschutz.rightsText: You have the right to access, correct and delete your data, to restrict its processing, to data portability, and to complain to a supervisory authority. Contact the address in the legal notice to do so.
